Positives: strongest frameworks, self-ID, X markers, no arrest basis affirmed 2011-2024, functioning courts awarding compensation for trans discrimination, anti-discrimination covering GI, housing protection, tourist guide ranks among most welcoming.

So the worst feature: prison placement by birth sex (tier 1, contingent on arrest), plus some documented service/threat denial (UN committee, some trans people report denial of access to spaces/services and threats — tier 3), recurring hate speech, 38% differential treatment.

Rule 21 band implication: universal-exposure practices without documented remedy... prison placement is universal-exposure but only in custody. Facility access denial "some trans people report denial of access to spaces and services" — that's a documented exposure but vague, thin.

This dossier: no documented traveler-specific friction at all, but documented prison placement ruling and service denial reports.
